items.text: A Next JS corporate website suits firms with many service pages, team profiles, news updates and downloads. Pages stay fast on mobile networks and keep a stable layout while loading, which helps both visitors and rankings.

items.title: Next JS SEO Website Builds
items.text: A next js seo website is planned for search from day one. That means server-rendered HTML, clean URLs, unique metadata on every page, structured data and an XML sitemap. Search engines and AI crawlers can read the full content without running scripts.

items.title: Web Applications and Server Rendering
items.text: Next JS app router development lets us build quote builders, account areas and internal tools inside the same project as your public website. Next JS server side rendering creates each page when it is requested, which suits content that changes often, such as prices or stock levels. Next JS server components keep heavy code on the server, so the browser downloads less JavaScript.

sections.h2: Next JS vs React and Next JS vs WordPress

paragraphs.text: Next JS vs React: React is a library for building interfaces. Next.js is a framework built on React that adds routing, server rendering and image optimisation. For public pages that must rank, Next.js is usually the better fit. For apps that sit behind a login, plain React often works well.

Next JS vs WordPress: WordPress is a content management system with themes and plugins. Next.js gives you a custom-coded site with fewer plugin updates to manage and faster pages, but it needs a developer for structural changes.

Next JS incremental static regeneration combines both strengths. Pages are pre-built for speed, then refreshed in the background when your content changes. In the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, about one in five developers reported using Next.js.

sections.h2: How Much Does a Next JS Website Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: Cost depends on the number of pages, languages, integrations and custom features. A 10 page company website costs far less than a multilingual site with a web application behind it.

Web applications and custom builds are quoted per project after discovery, and maintenance plans start from Rs. 3,000 per month. Kochi rates are usually well below UAE, UK or North American agency rates for the same scope. Every quote from our Next JS development company Kochi office is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

Hosting is a separate, smaller cost. Most business sites run comfortably on Vercel or a managed cloud plan, and we recommend the option that fits your traffic and budget before launch rather than after.

items.q: What is Next JS used for?
items.a: Next.js is used to build fast websites and web applications on top of React. Common uses include company websites, product sites, content-heavy blogs and web apps that need good search visibility. It renders pages on the server, so content appears immediately for visitors and for search engines.

items.q: Is Next JS better for SEO than React?
items.a: Yes, for public pages it usually is. Plain React sends a mostly empty page that the browser fills in, while Next.js sends complete HTML on the first request. That makes content easier for Google and AI crawlers to read and index.

items.q: How long does it take to build a Next JS website?
items.a: A 10 to 15 page website usually takes 4 to 6 weeks. A large site or a web application takes 8 to 12 weeks. We confirm your timeline in writing after the discovery stage.

items.q: Why choose Next JS for business websites?
items.a: Next.js gives business websites fast loading, strong SEO foundations and room to grow into a web application later. Content can be edited easily, and the same codebase can serve several languages and markets.

items.q: Can Next JS handle high traffic?
items.a: Yes. Pre-built and cached pages are served from a global network, so traffic spikes from campaigns or news coverage rarely slow the site down. Server-rendered pages scale with your hosting plan.
